bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to labor and industry; appropriating money for hiring to support activities under the Safe Workplaces for Meat and Poultry Processing Workers Act.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$163,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of labor and industry for one added full-time equivalent position to support activities under the Safe Workplaces for Meat and Poultry Processing Workers Act under Minnesota Statutes, sections 179.87 to 179.877. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to labor and industry; appropriating money for hiring to support activities under the Safe Workplaces for Meat and Poultry Processing Workers Act.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$163,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of labor and industry for one added full-time equivalent position to support activities under the Safe Workplaces for Meat and Poultry Processing Workers Act under Minnesota Statutes, sections 179.87 to 179.877.
additions: $163,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of labor and industry for one added full-time equivalent position to support activities under the Safe Workplaces for Meat and Poultry Processing Workers Act under Minnesota Statutes, sections 179.87 to 179.877.
